errors.evidence: The countries on the horizontal axis are not sorted in alphabetical order. For example, 'Нидерландия' (Н) is followed by 'Обединено...' (О) and then 'Дания' (Д). The countries are sorted in descending order based on their value on the y-axis.
The bar for the last country, 'Румъния', which has the lowest value, is clearly above the 0.6000 mark on the y-axis, not around 0.4000.
